photos.desc: Yucatán Black Howler Monkey ( Alouatta pigra )

Alouatta pigra . Photo taken in Belize. Note that the source page calls this a "Mexican black howler monkey" but A. pigra is the Guatemalan Black Howler . The Mexican Howler Monkey is A. palliata mexi

Yucatán Black Howler Monkey ( Alouatta pigra )
Fotografía de un juvenil de mono aullador negro en el municipio de Oxcabal, Campeche, México.
Location taken: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History. Names: Alouatta villosa Gray, 1845, Águila colorada, Howler, Káně černohrdl Classification: Animalia > Chordata > Mammalia > Primates >
